meta.title: Purchase requests: AI opportunities
meta.subtitle: Where AI could help along the purchase process, named by Client A or suggested by us.

ai.title: Read each request form into the tracker
ai.does: Reads the request form from the email and fills in the tracker, so Team A no longer logs each request by hand.

cite.quote: We would like AI to read the request form and log it for us

agentic.trigger: A request form arrives by email.
steps: Read the request form.
Fill in the tracker fields from the form.
Flag any field the form leaves empty.
Send the new entry to Team A.

decides.what: checks the entry and accepts it or corrects it

agentic.logging: Each run records the form, the fields it filled and what Team A changed.

ai.title: Chase suppliers that have not confirmed
ai.does: Watches for orders the supplier has not confirmed and sends a reminder, so Team C only handles the replies.

cite.quote: If we could automate the chasing

agentic.trigger: An order has no confirmation in the supplier portal.
steps: Find orders with no confirmation.
Draft a reminder to the supplier.
Send the reminder once Team C agrees.
Mark the order as chased in the tracker.

decides.what: reads each reminder and sends it or holds it

agentic.logging: Each reminder is kept with the order, with who sent it and when.

ai.title: Draft the approval pack
ai.does: Puts the request, the chosen quote and the budget code into a draft pack for Team B to check before it goes to the approver.

cite.quote: An AI draft of the approval pack would help Team B too

agentic.trigger: The quotes are compared and the budget code is confirmed.
steps: Collect the request, the quotes and the budget code.
Draft the approval pack.
Send the draft to Team B.

decides.what: edits the draft and sends it to the approver

agentic.logging: Each draft is saved beside the final pack, so the changes Team B made can be seen.

ai.title: Compare supplier quotes side by side
ai.does: Lays the quotes out in one table with price and terms, so Team C picks from one view instead of comparing by hand.

cite.reading: Team C compares the quotes by hand, which repeats work for each request

agentic.trigger: The quotes for a request have arrived in the supplier portal.
steps: Read each quote.
Build one table of price and terms.
Mark the cheapest suitable quote.
agentic.logging: The table and the chosen quote are saved with the request.

ai.title: Match invoices to orders and deliveries
ai.does: Checks each invoice against its order and the delivery, and passes clean matches to Finance for payment.

cite.reading: Finance matches each invoice to the order and the delivery by hand

steps: Find the order and the delivery for the invoice.
Compare the amounts and the items.
Pass clean matches on and list the rest.

decides.what: approves each payment and resolves each mismatch

agentic.logging: Each match records the invoice, the order, the delivery and the decision.

ai.title: Check requests are complete on arrival
ai.does: Checks each new request for missing details before it is logged, so fewer requests go back to the requester.

cite.reading: Incomplete requests go back to the requester and cause rework

agentic.trigger: A request form arrives by email.
steps: Check each required field.
List what is missing.
Draft a reply to the requester.

decides.what: sends the reply or logs the request as it is

agentic.logging: Each check records the fields it found missing and what Team A did.

ai.title: Keep the requester informed at every stage
ai.does: Sends the requester a short note each time the request moves to a new view, so fewer people ask where a request is.

cite.reading: The requester hears only at intake and at ordering today

agentic.trigger: A request changes stage in the tracker.
steps: Read the new stage.
Draft a short note to the requester.
Send the note once Team A agrees.

decides.what: reads the note and sends it or holds it

agentic.logging: Each note is kept with the request, with when it was sent.
